outcome: Neurological problems (abnormalities of muscle tone and neonatal reflexes)
cohort: Term neonates (inborn or outborn) with hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE), arriving within 6 hours of delivery
finding: Magnesium sulphate administration in term neonates with HIE resulted in significantly better outcomes at discharge, including earlier establishment of suck feeding, reduced seizure duration, and fewer neurological problems, compared to the control group.
